buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 2. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of Officer Commanding, Station Health Organization, Kolkata payable at Kolkata . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Bidders have to submit the following documents without which bidders will be disqualified in technical evaluation. 1 ESI Registration Certificate Copy of ESI Certificate should be attached. 2 EPF Registration Certificate Copy of EPF Registration Certificate should be attached. 3 GST Registration Certificate The firm should have valid GST Registration Number. Copy of the same sh ould be attached. 3 PAN CARD The firm should have valid PAN Card in the name of firm or in the name of proprietor of the firm in case of proprietary firm. Copy of the same is to be enclosed. 4 Labour License The firm should have labour licence. Copy of the same is to be enclosed. 5 Annual Turnover Annual Turnover for last three Financial Years Certified by Chartered Accountant as s pecified in the bid documents should be enclosed with the bid. 6 Bidders' Financial Standing Certificate/ Undertaking for non liquidation, non bankrupt, non blacklisting, no court receivership or any such similar proceedings ongoing, no pointers from EOW of Govt of India shou ld be enclosed along with the bid. 7 Office Location The vendor should have main/ branch office anywhere in the state of West Bengal. If n ot, undertaking/ declaration should be enclosed for establishment of the same within 30 days from the dat e of award of contract. 8 Declaration is required to be attached for extension of the duration of present contract for another six m onths in case required by the buyer. Payment Clause 9 Payment to be made within stipulated time i.e. 5th day of every months. 10 Payment to be strictly as per contract i.e. within profit margin. No extra charges will be levied from the employees. 11 Adherence to the contract is mandatory. 12 EPF/ESI to be paid as per extant rules and proof to be submitted monthly. 13 Bills need to submitted by 10th of every month for necessary clearance. 14 ePBG to be given 5% of the contract value after issuance of contract. The ePBG should be valid for 20

months from the date of contract as the contract may be extended upto 50% of the contract period. 15 GST bill only be paid on minimum wages and not on ESI and EPF or other elements. Acceptance of the s ame is mandatory to be provided by the vendor for technical evaluation. 16 Total contract will be finalized by competent financial authority in concurrence of the Integrated Financi al Advisor and same will be applicable to all vendors. No alteration of amount will be allowed except in cas e of revision of pay made by Govt of India, Ministry of Labour. 17 Any violation to the above mentioned clauses will be subject to termination of contract at any point of t ime during the tenure of contract. . 4. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider
